verdict.rationale: Productboard offers a Webhooks API for real-time entity-change notifications and a REST API for feedback. Those pieces could trigger externally built automations, but only through custom developer work. There is no evidence of a native workflow builder, and SLA, trial-extension or discount actions would have to live in other systems. Missing for 10: native no-code workflow automation, explicit feedback-event triggers, built-in SLA/trial-extension/discount actions, independent corroboration.
